command:
set -eu
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
install -d -m 700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
if [ ! -f /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa ]; then runuser -u opsadmin -- ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 3072 -N '' -C 'opsadmin@node1' -f /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa; fi
cp /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys

cat > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config <<EOF
Host local-host
    HostName $NODE_IP
    User opsadmin
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa
    IdentitiesOnly yes
    BatchMode yes
    PasswordAuthentication no
    KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
    StrictHostKeyChecking yes
    UserKnownHostsFile ~/.ssh/known_hosts
    HostKeyAlgorithms rsa-sha2-512,rsa-sha2-256
    UpdateHostKeys no
EOF
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa
chmod 644 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
chown -R opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
restorecon -RF /home/opsadmin/.ssh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
printf 'account='; id opsadmin

command:
set -eu
backup=/home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts.benchmark-backup
fake=/home/opsadmin/.ssh/fake_host_rsa
cp -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts "$backup"
cleanup() { cp -p "$backup" /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts; rm -f "$backup" "$fake" "$fake.pub"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
runuser -u opsadmin -- ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 2048 -N '' -f "$fake"
awk -v host="$NODE_IP" '{print host " " $1 " " $2}' "$fake.pub" > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts
set +e
reject_output=$(timeout 10 runuser -u opsadmin -- ssh -F /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config local-host true </dev/null 2>&1)
reject_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'mismatch_exit=%s\n' "$reject_rc"
printf '%s\n' "$reject_output" | grep -E 'REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED|Host key verification failed'
[ "$reject_rc" -ne 0 ]
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'pin_restored='; awk '{print $2 " " $3}' /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts | cmp -s - <(awk '{print $1 " " $2}' /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key.pub) 2>/dev/null && echo yes || { awk '{print $2 " " $3}' /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts > /tmp/pinned.pub; awk '{print $1 " " $2}' /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key.pub > /tmp/server.pub; cmp -s /tmp/pinned.pub /tmp/server.pub && echo yes; rm -f /tmp/pinned.pub /tmp/server.pub; }
runuser -u opsadmin -- ssh -F /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config local-host 'printf "restored_login_user="; id -un'
